svg.aria-label: Tenancy: tenants share the cluster and platform services; each gets an operator-owned landing zone of delivery scope, quota, default-deny network, its own identity realm, admission policy and scoped secrets, and ships its workloads from its own repository.

svg.text: Guardrails live in the operator's repository, workloads in the tenant's. A tenant ships what it likes into its namespaces,

text.font-family: MF Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: and cannot widen its own quota, access or network policy. New tenants start from the same blueprint, provisioned with Crossplane.
